title: French Food
description: French Food is a modification that adds French cuisine with new crafting methods and mechanics.
body:
French Food is a mod that adds French food. Currently, the mod only has a baguette and 3 types of croissants, but the mod will be updated and expanded for different mod installers.
Croissant with berry jam
Croissant with poppy seeds
Croissant with berry jam and poppy seeds
